title: Entropic and algebraic transcript-based tools in time series analysis
summary: Algebraic representations of time series are symbolic representations whose symbols belong to a finite group. Precisely, the framework of the present paper is the analysis of coupled time series in algebraic representations and, more generally, group-valued time series. The prototype of an algebraic representation is an ordinal representation, whose symbols are permutations, also called ordinal patterns in the context of time series analysis.
